'''Revelation At Last We Will Reveal Ourselves To The Jedi (BHBM)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 8 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 BHBM Revelation DS 2003 AtLastWe.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

At last we will have revenge. They will be no match for us?the Dark Lords of the Sith. With our allies, surely we will hunt down and destroy the Jedi. Their fire will go out of the universe. Without them, the Brotherhood of the sith shall rule.

Luke?he is your master now.

The published list has 67 cards.

== Strategy ==

(Note: Strategy has been changed. Read it). First things first. Okay, the title and first sentence of the description is Maul talking. The second- Emperor Palpatine. The third; Vader. Fourth-Emperor. Fifth-Maul. Sixth-Vader. This is my best BHBM- ever. If it's no good, oh well. In it, the Sith, the Allies, and the Sith Allies all work together for one cause: the destruction of Jedi and Rebels! First turn, pull Dannik Jerriko and Back Door. Activate. Get DS2 db. I don't recommend deploying anything. Emperor Palpatine is going to come out of your deck when it?s appropriate. Second turn, pull Blast Door Controls (evasion killer) and either Spaceport to your opponent's planet or get the Endor db. If your opponent is ready to be attacked, do so. Otherwise, wait, perhaps draw a bit. Next turn, get Spaceport/Coruscant db. If he STILL hasn't done ANYTHING, deploy cards. But that's no fun. Let's talk about stacking cards. Deploy DS2 Emperor from Reserve Deck; grab Force Lightning. Don't be afraid to use the Lost gametext; you have a backup Emperor, remember. However, unless your opponent hits him, try to make him stick around until you?re out of Force Lightnings, then feel free to lose him. Try to deploy him to a juicy drain at opponent's planet; otherwise, stick him at the Back Door. Maul plays a key role in your hunt of the Jedi. Darth Maul, Young Apprentice kills them in battle, immune to Clash Of Sabers, or duels them with Maul Strikes. Darth Maul duels them with his gametext, ignoring all other characters. This deck is meant to kill all Jedi. Besides Luke, Vader can take on all Jedi. Maul takes on all Jedi; as well as Luke! Lose a force to duel them (with a tracked Ommni Box and Masterful Move, or whatever), lose a force to place them out of play. 4-LOM cancels either Jedi's immunity, or their permanent weapons. Either way, you kill them. IG-88 can easily capture one of them combined with a used Force Lightning. The weaker characters you beatdown on. Dannik gets the scrubs out of play. Okay?where are all their characters??? If there's only a few left, he?s compelled to deploy them instead of getting drained out. Beatdown=stack= crossing of Luke. I would play Deep Hatred, but it prohibits Sniper and You Are Beaten. A couple explanations?Masterful Move and Ommni Box are mainly for tracking and screwing up opponent's tracking/hand. Kintan Strider would be good, but what would I cut? Suggestions, please? Also, suggestions for cuts for End This Destructive Conflict? Matchups:

HB: Hope he isn't playing Luke?hehheh.

RTP: Blast R2 to a million pieces if he?s not protecting him.

TIGIH: Outfight him; let him make the first move. Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan, two important characters, will be no more.

QMC: Blast Door controls= evasion killer : )

Profit: Don't start anybody; but also don?t let him free Han.

Okay, that was the 'special' strategy. The rest; just make sure Luke gets brought before him, and then takes his father's place. If he evades his destiny, he loses 3 force a turn.
